title: Carry out compulsory recalls of consumer goods
what: When the Minister issues a compulsory recall notice, the suppliers it names must take the actions it requires, such as recalling the goods.

sources.title: Competition and Consumer Act 2010
sources.quote: 123 Contents of a recall notice (1) A recall notice for the consumer goods may require one or more suppliers of the goods, or (if no such supplier is known to the responsible Minister who issued the notice) the regulator, to take one or more of the following actions: (a) recall the goods;

sources.title: Competition and Consumer Act 2010
sources.quote: (2) The Commission must not issue more than one infringement notice to the person for the same alleged contravention of the civil penalty provision of the industry code.

administration.who: State and territory consumer protection agencies (fair trading offices)

sources.title: Competition and Consumer Act 2010
sources.quote: Part XIAA—Application of the Australian Consumer Law as a law of a State or Territory 140 Definitions In this Part: application law means: (a) a law of a participating jurisdiction that applies the applied Australian Consumer Law, either with or without modifications, as a law of the participating jurisdiction;

sources.title: Where to go for consumer help
